column1: # Disco Elysium - The Final Cut on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Unity 2020.3.12f1 IL2CPP with FMOD, SDK 11.4.3, NVN; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie. Base v0, display 1.0.7.
# 6,165 shaders from the package, 56 of them compute, all translated; Unity 2020.3's ComputeShader layout recovers 55 kernels from unity default
# resources (type hash d0171b849bb064b2424893e7d4809be5), so the six shaders once captured at runtime are table rows now (4df74f72c570dd06
# Tested 2026-11-10/11 with these tables, a source-only split and no captures, on a Sony XQ-DQ72 (Adreno 740) and a OnePlus 15 (Snapdragon 8 Elite
# Gen 5), 2 h on each: every region visited, menus, saves written and loaded, a steady 30 fps, no crash; 56/56 compute pipelines, no missing-program
# draws, the VP8 and AVC intro movies decoded.
# Handheld, no forced 60 fps, turbo or diagnostic overrides. Cold pipeline compilation and scene loading still stall; shader coverage is scene-dependent.
